Subject: Calibration session — exception escrow & band conciliation

Team —

Attaching the updated Q3 calibration packet and a short examples sheet for anchor raters. Key asks ahead of Monday's calibration:

- Please review the "sensitive exceptions" slate (tab 3 in the packet) and flag any candidates you believe need an escrow hold for further evidence prior to final banding.
- Bring one anonymized evidence item per disputed case (redacted 1:1 notes, output samples, manager summary). We will not circulate PII; anonymization guidance in the template.
- Marcus/Laura: can one of you own the anchor-rater moderation? We want consistent scoring across cross-functional comparators.

I expect a tighter agenda than prior rounds — we have three inter-team contests where we need a firm decision or a documented escrow. If a band reversal is proposed, we will follow the sign-off path below (Vivek, you may want to confirm).

Proposed meeting: Mon Jul 5, 10:00–11:30 PT (calendar link below). If you cannot make it, mark comments in the packet and indicate proxy.

Attachments: Q3_calibration_packet_v2.pdf, anchor_rater_examples.xlsx, sensitive_exception_template.docx

Thanks,
Naomi

Agree with the approach. A couple of governance points from my side:

- Any proposed band reversal that would change comp band must get HR + People Director sign-off. For reversals that materially affect quota/commission or require payout adjustments, we need Exec approval (I will flag those before the meeting if they exist).
- For escrowed cases: define a 30-day evidence window and a single manager follow-up attempt (documented). If evidence doesn't arrive in-window, we default to the conservative band (no upward movement).

One ask for presenters: mark every row that is being proposed for escalation with the tag [ESCALATE] so the moderator can triage quickly.

Vivek

Head of Engineering Operations

Thanks, everyone — summary and next steps: 

1) Moderation: Laura + Marcus will co-moderate anchor scoring. Marcus will run anonymized scoring; Laura will timebox debate.
2) Sign-offs: Band reversals require HR + People Director sign-off; Exec approval only for changes that impact comp payouts. Vivek will flag any candidate reversals ahead of the meeting.
3) Escrow: 30-day evidence window; manager must upload follow-up in the template. If no evidence, default to conservative band.
4) Packet: expect Marcus' inline notes by EOD Friday; Laura will add the 3-slide cross-team delta.
5) Meeting: Mon Jul 5, 10:00–11:30 PT. Calendar invite: https://calendar.company.com/event/6h3k2n
